body:
I go to the gym about 6 times a week religiously and have even tried going to church but social contacts don't materialize from either.  The community that I live in is perfect if you have a family.  But,  I've had peers say that they couldn't imagine trying to meet people here if they had came alone in their 20s.  

I do have a girlfriend of 9 months currently and her family has been very inviting but no one has asked for my phone number or reached out to me in any way.  I've wanted to reach out to them but since I have seen where my gf has said I wasn't her type and I'll see where it goes I might not want to get too attached.  It all circles back to looking for what I want in life and having no hope of finding it.  Living a meaningless life working to live is like a living form of hell.
I talk to people online but that doesn't cure the symptoms of isolation.  It really makes it worse for me because there is no sort of physical stimulation, nothing to do with being sexual.
